question: How do I request a refund?
answer: Open My Orders, select the order and choose Request Refund. Once approved, the money goes back to your original payment method.

question: When will I receive my refund?
answer: Refunds are processed within 5 to 7 business days after approval. Your bank may take a few extra days to show the amount.

question: I was charged twice for the same order. What should I do?
answer: Duplicate charges are usually temporary holds that disappear in 3 to 5 days. If both amounts remain, share your order number and we will reverse the extra charge.

question: How can I get a copy of my invoice?
answer: Open My Orders, select the order and choose Download Invoice. A PDF invoice is also emailed to you after every purchase.

question: Which payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept credit cards, debit cards, UPI, net banking and popular wallets. Cash on delivery is available on selected pin codes.

question: How do I cancel my order?
answer: Open My Orders, select the order and choose Cancel Order. Orders can be cancelled until they are shipped.

question: Can I change my order after placing it?
answer: Items, size or quantity can be changed within 1 hour of placing the order from My Orders. After that, cancel the order and place a new one.

question: How do I check the status of my order?
answer: Open My Orders and select your order to see its current status. You also receive status updates by email and SMS.

question: I received a wrong or damaged item. What now?
answer: Report it within 7 days from My Orders with a photo of the item. We will arrange a free replacement or a refund.

question: How long does delivery take?
answer: Standard delivery takes 3 to 7 business days depending on your location. Express delivery takes 1 to 2 business days.

question: How can I track my package?
answer: Use the tracking link in your shipping confirmation email or open My Orders and choose Track Package.

question: My package has not arrived. What should I do?
answer: First check the tracking page for the latest status. If it is more than 3 days past the expected date, contact us with your order number and we will investigate with the courier.

question: Can I change my delivery address?
answer: The address can be changed before the order is shipped from My Orders. After shipping, contact support quickly so we can ask the courier to redirect it.

question: What are the shipping charges?
answer: Shipping is free on orders above the minimum order value shown at checkout. Below that, a small flat delivery fee applies.

question: How do I reset my password?
answer: Choose Forgot Password on the login page and enter your registered email. A reset link will be sent to you and stays valid for 30 minutes.

question: How do I update my email address or phone number?
answer: Go to Account Settings, then Profile, edit the details and verify the new email or phone with the code we send.

question: How do I cancel my subscription?
answer: Go to Account Settings, then Subscriptions, and choose Cancel Subscription. You keep access until the end of the current billing period.

question: How do I delete my account?
answer: Go to Account Settings and choose Delete Account. Deletion is permanent and removes your order history and saved details.

question: How can I contact customer support?
answer: You can reach us through the Help section of the app, by email or by phone. We reply to emails within 24 hours.

question: What are your support hours?
answer: Our phone and chat support is available from 9 AM to 9 PM, Monday to Saturday. Email support is monitored every day.

question: How do I submit feedback or a suggestion?
answer: Use the Give Feedback option in the Help section or email our feedback address. Every suggestion is reviewed by our team.

question: How do I talk to a real person or human agent?
answer: Choose Talk to an Agent in the Help section, or call our support number during support hours. A human agent will take over from the chatbot.
